title: Rhea Authority
prompt:
Rhea stands centered in the cathedral antechamber, serene and unreadable, while Seteth holds a watchful position behind her. Candlelight and stained-glass glow move subtly across stone and fabric. Rhea barely moves: a small breath and a calm turn of the eyes are enough. The shot should establish gentle but immovable church authority.

Camera: slow symmetrical push-in from a low angle. Rhea must remain a breathtakingly beautiful young adult woman in her mid-20s with smooth youthful skin; express ancient dragon divinity through calm sacred authority, not wrinkles, eye bags, tired texture, or middle-aged features.
negative_prompt: No game UI, no subtitles, no readable text, no watermark, no modern objects. No identity drift, face swaps, costume drift, extra limbs, warped hands, flickering faces, or sudden style changes. Avoid: villain grin, throne-room excess, aggressive gestures, text. Avoid old Rhea, middle-aged Rhea, tired priestess face, wrinkles, eye bags. No middle-aged face unless canonically required, no old face, no wrinkles, no tired eye bags, no harsh pores, no weathered skin, no gaunt face, no matronly look, no gritty realism, no generic medieval extra. Keep academy students youthful, attractive, clean-skinned and official-game-inspired; for war phase students, keep them early-20s and beautiful, showing war pressure through costume, posture, lighting and setting, not through aging.
